executive_summary: Ep 114 advances Butler-assassination and Epstein-files threads. Tucker Carlson tells host (per Dan Bongino) that Trump shut down the Butler investigation; Bongino's on-camera rebuttal and displayed text messages appear to confirm withheld information and a 'pending inactive' case status. A NYT article is read showing Trump phoned Charlie Kirk on 2025-07-12 to scold him over Epstein advocacy at SAS. Candace surfaces her own Tucker-Maine interview clip stating 'Israel's controlling our government' and recalling Tucker describing Erika as anti-Israel at a Maine dinner; contrasted against Erika's pro-Israel Calvary Chapel speech 2025-07-14. FOIA response on Bradley Hansel's SAM702 Fort Wuka trip invokes inter-agency consultation, queue position #3534. Erika's Women's Summit post-heckling clip replayed.

claims.label: Host says the Butler story terrified Dan Bongino and Kash Patel
claims.claim: Recapping Tucker Carlson's account that he asked Dan Bongino and Kash Patel why the public was told Thomas Matthew Crooks had no social media history, the host says the Butler story, "perhaps the butler cover up", terrified Bongino and Patel.
